subject: E-Commerce
title: Mobile Money in Africa
description: A micro-lesson that makes Mobile Money in Africa usable.

hook.text: M-Pesa processes $314 billion annually in Africa. Mobile phones replaced banks for 400 million unbanked people.

buildup.text: In Kenya, 96% of households use M-Pesa. You send money, pay bills, and buy goods via SMS and a phone number.

discovery.text: Mobile money unlocked e-commerce in Africa. Without bank accounts, people couldn't shop online. M-Pesa changed that.

twist.text: Cross-border sellers who don't accept mobile money are invisible to Africa's 400 million e-commerce-ready consumers.

climax.text: M-Pesa proved that financial inclusion drives commerce. Connect people to payments and shopping follows.

punchline.text: $314B via phones, 400M new shoppers. M-Pesa gave unbanked Africa e-commerce.

quiz.question: Why is M-Pesa critical for African e-commerce?
options: It gives 400 million unbanked people a way to make digital payments
